title: Characterization of a sequence segment
statement: Let $\mu:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{Z}$, let $a\in\mathbb{N}$, and let $x\in\mathbb{Z}$ and $l$ be a finite list of integers. The values of $\mu$ starting at index $a$ agree with the list obtained by placing $x$ before $l$ if and only if $\mu(a)=x$ and the values starting at index $a+1$ agree with $l$.
